reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-FP — The sink expression at lines 77-79 writes to the HTTP response using org.owasp.benchmark.helpers.Utils.encodeForHTML(bar). Although 'bar' originates from user input (getQueryString), the resolved sink value is the HTML-encoded version of 'bar'. As demonstrated in Example 1 (BenchmarkTest02272), explicit encoding at the response sink mitigates the XSS vulnerability, rendering the finding a false positive.

evidence.note: Response sink writes 'bar' wrapped in Utils.encodeForHTML(), providing HTML escaping mitigation.
doSomething method confirms 'bar' is passed directly from 'param' (user input) without prior sanitization, relying entirely on the sink-side encoding.
